notes.title: Patch 2.5
notes.notes:
Hey all! There is a new update here! With this update, there were some small bug fixes and a performance issue. It's mainly a memory leak.

With that done. The newest hero Crimson is now available!
With this hero, he controls blood and drains it from his foes. Hop in the game now to test him out!

notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.notes:
Hey all! With this patch, I have fixed a decent amount of things. Mainly gold. Now you're being given a certain amount on different difficulties. You moved the UI around so it's not completely in your way. It made Thy Unknown way stronger.

So with the basic fixes out of the way I would like to announce a new hero is in the works and a new area. They have not had work done on them just yet, as I want to focus on planning right now.

Have an amazing day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.notes:
Hey all! So this is an everyday update. It's sizable so I didn't want to include it in the small patches section.

So let's get down to it.

Once again, I've changed many things with the end game. I've made it to where the void has more enemy variety and functions as one. I've also added more enemy variety to the Dune and Fire areas as well. 

I've also decreased the amount of gold needed to upgrade healing by half.

I've added more ways of getting gold and decreased its rarity from enemies.
Gold now drops from bosses. The amount might be changed in the future though.

That's it besides a few little tweaks here and there.

Let me know what you think.

Have an amazing day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.2
notes.notes:
Hey all! Really large update here. We are adding new enemies to end-game content and UI changes.

So with this update, I will say this one gave me some trouble and will also be reworked. They are mainly just end-game enemies. Not all bosses have their enemy types so this will be fixed in the future.

I have added new UI elements to further show you the moveset of the heroes. I saw a lot of people playing the game not knowing you can jump or dash. So here that is. 

I have also reworked healing. You can upgrade it now. So each hero does not have a healing stat. This is for simplicity's sake so trying to level a new hero is not such a drag.

Xp rates have also been adjusted so grinding is not a terrible drag anymore. Each difficulty has had its cap expanded way more!

There were way more changes but for now, this is all. 

I hope you have a great day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.notes: Hey all! So with this small patch, I have just fixed a bug and reworked ascension slightly. Each ascension button now shows the hero's ascension level. I also fixed a bug with the restart button when pausing. I also removed some portraits that were not supposed to be there—easy small QOL fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Hey all! It's a pretty sizable update here. I've changed quite a bit so make sure to reset progress! This update will break your saves. So with this update, I've brought back music. I have also added the new boss event. This is a new way to grind XP and max your hero out. Level caps have been brought back. You can also now unlock Enlisters. They're the latest change to the game. They're something to look forward to unlocking as they can help quickly level your heroes. Or optionally you don't ever have to use them. They're there to make grinding less tedious for you.

So with this new update, I hope you like it. Now and then the boss for the events will change and there will be more to come in the future. This also means I will be skipping making new factions and changing the map as we currently know it. It will be larger and more roaming will be happening. 

Again I hope you like and until next time. 

- Alex :)

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey all! This is a pretty sizeable update here. With the new update comes 10 new enlisters and I have attempted to fix an XP bug. I have also brought back the old buttons for heroes on the hero selection screen. 

This will be a final patch as I will be working on the next one for a good minute. This next patch will include a new faction. I am finally going to start on that next. I will also be bringing music back, I am just trying to iron out some bugs with that.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey all! The 1.1 patch is now available! In this patch come some decently sized changes and some smaller ones.

This patch's main takeaway is the new shop and menu changes. It's a lot to go over so hop in the game and see it yourself.

You can now enlist 5 new enemies to help you throughout your journey to help you tackle new difficulties with a new hero. This should make the game far more easier. 

There are two new currencies to collect. Gold and emerald dollars. This is to slow the process but make a balanced change to summons.

notes.title: 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Hey all! So you've seen the devlogs right? The update is officially complete. This is now update 1.0.

With this update comes tons and tons of changes. I hope you all enjoy and have fun with this update.

With 1.0 comes 5 new heroes and new ways to progress. There is also a secret boss so have fun trying to find it! 

I am excited and happy with this update.

Have a good one! 

- Alex!
